16 Ann Arbor hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on October 3, 2026 for Nov 7 to Nov 9, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Ann Arbor hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 16 Ann Arbor hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 5, the hotel's own site at 3, KAYAK.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Evendo at 1 and Super.com at 1. These are the Ann Arbor rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 14 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Ann Arbor hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
